parties.petitioner: Maatr Sparsh An Initiative By Avyaan Foundation

summary: Public interest petition for mandamus to establish breastfeeding and childcare facilities in public places; rights under Article 21, 39(f), 47, and international conventions (UNCRC, UDHR); State obligation to ensure dignity and health of nursing mothers and infants; advisory dated 27.02.2024 recognized; directions issued to States/UTs to comply; fundamental right to breastfeed linked to child's survival and mother's autonomy; international standards cited; no relief for petitioner NGO beyond compliance with advisory.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
Universal Declaration of Human Rights Art.25(2)
UN Convention on the Rights of the Child Art.3
UN Convention on the Rights of the Child Art.7
UN Convention on the Rights of the Child Art.24
final_judgment: Directions issued to all States/Union Territories to comply with the Central Government advisory dated 27.02.2024 for setting up breastfeeding and childcare facilities in public places; petition disposed of in light of compliance mechanism.
